subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive - FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Hughes <ben.hughes@finpath.com>, Alice Tan <alice.tan@finpath.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-02-27T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (demo scheduling)

Hi Ben / Alice —

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about FinPath's plans for an embedded AI assistant for your account aggregation flow. Quick recap from my side: 

- Primary goal: reduce manual reconciliation and improve support triage using an assistant for account normalization and intent extraction.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms median latency on lookups, PII minimization, SOC2-aligned controls.
- Stakeholders: Product (Ben), Ops/Security (Alice), Procurement (TBD).

Next steps: we'd love to run a product demo + technical deep dive (runtime, data flow, security) with your engineering and security teams. Proposed times (all PT):
- Wed Mar 3, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu Mar 4, 1:00–2:00 PM PT
- Fri Mar 5, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Please let me know which slot works or share a few alternatives. If you want, I can loop in our security and platform leads to cover compliance and integration details.

I attached a short mutual action plan to help coordinate internal owners.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: FinPath-MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — that summary looks right.

Of the proposed times, Thu Mar 4 1–2 PM PT works best for our team. If you can get your security lead on that call too, that'd be ideal.

Ben Hughes

ben.hughes@finpath.com

Adding Neha (security) and Dev (platform) from Redwood — they'll cover SOC2 controls, encryption, and how our private deployments work for regulated data.

1) 10 min — Customer priorities & success metrics (Ben)
2) 20 min — Product demo (Marissa / Demo)
3) 20 min — Technical deep dive (Dev) + security controls (Neha)
4) 10 min — Procurement ask / next contractual steps (Procurement)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-01T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + next steps (demo scheduling)

Hi Ben / team — Neha here (Security, Redwood). I can join Thu Mar 4 1–2 PM PT. A couple of quick items we typically review in the pre-call or during the deep dive:

- SOC 2 Type II report (we can send our latest report and summary of controls).
- Data flow diagram: where customer PII is processed/stored.
- Encryption at rest / in transit and key management (we support KMS/HSM integrations).
- Data retention and deletion policies for cached embeddings / logs.

Ben — can you confirm whether FinPath will be sending sample (anonymized) data for an integration plan, or if you'd prefer a sandbox integration first? If you can share any regulatory constraints (e.g., data residency), please include them.

I'll attach our SOC 2 summary and a short security FAQ to the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Hughes <ben.hughes@finpath.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finpath.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + next steps (demo scheduling)

Hey all — Dev from Platform. I can join the Thu slot as well. For the technical deep dive I plan to cover:

- Integration patterns (hosted API vs private/VPC options) and expected latency characteristics
- Typical batching and caching strategies to meet sub-200ms goals and token-cost implications
- What artifacts we need from FinPath to size the integration (sample request rates, average sequence length, any PII/PI requirements)

Ben — if you can share expected qps or a short sample of request shapes (anonymized), that'd help us prepare a short performance sketch for the call. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Platform Lead | Redwood Inference
